title: CladeWelcome
description: A lightweight and customizable welcome plugin focused on performance, stability, and simplicity.
body:
# CladeWelcome

A powerful and lightweight Minecraft welcome plugin focused on performance, customization, and compatibility.

---

## ⭐ Why CladeWelcome?

CladeWelcome is designed for server owners who want a clean and modern join experience without unnecessary complexity.

### Main Features

* Customizable welcome messages
* PlaceholderAPI support
* BossBar support
* Custom sounds
* Multi-language system
* Player feature toggles
* Database support
* Performance-focused design
* Supports Paper, Purpur, and Spigot

---

## 📢 Project Status

CladeWelcome has reached a mature and stable state.

At this time, the project is considered feature-complete and no major new features are planned.

Future updates will primarily focus on:

* Minecraft version compatibility updates
* Bug fixes
* Stability improvements
* Security improvements
* Performance optimizations
* Dependency updates

The goal is to keep CladeWelcome lightweight, stable, and reliable for long-term server use rather than continuously adding new features.

Thank you to everyone who has supported the project and helped improve it over time.

---

## 🏆 Recommended Version

### CladeWelcome v1.0.0.0.a

We currently recommend **v1.0.0.0.a** as the most stable version of CladeWelcome.

### Why v1.0.0.0.a?

* Very stable release
* Few known bugs
* Lightweight and optimized
* Excellent compatibility
* Reliable for production servers

While newer versions introduce many new features and improvements, we still recommend v1.0.0.0.a for servers that prioritize stability and long-term reliability.

If you want the smoothest experience possible, use **v1.0.0.0.a**.

You can always check newer releases and changelogs if you want to explore recently added features.

---

## 🆕 Latest Version Features

The latest versions include many additional features compared to v1.0.0.0.a:

* Advanced animation system
* Extended BossBar customization
* Additional player settings
* Database improvements
* Performance mode improvements
* Better language support
* More configuration options
* Improved update checking system
* Various bug fixes and optimizations

---

## ⚡ Performance Modes

### Light Mode

Recommended for small and medium servers.

* Better performance
* Lower memory usage
* Minimal resource consumption

### Heavy Mode

Recommended for larger servers.

* Full functionality
* Additional visual features
* Enhanced player experience

---

## 📋 Requirements

* Java 17+
* Minecraft 1.17.x - 1.21.x
* Paper, Purpur, or Spigot

### Optional Dependencies

* PlaceholderAPI
* MySQL
* LuckPerms

---

## 🛠 Commands

| Command    | Description          |
| ---------- | -------------------- |
| /cw        | Main command         |
| /cw help   | Show help            |
| /cw reload | Reload configuration |
| /cw status | Show plugin status   |
| /cw toggle | Toggle features      |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission         | Description             |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| cladewelcome.admin | Administrative commands |
| cladewelcome.use   | Player commands         |
| cladewelcome.op    | OP sound group          |

---

## 🌍 Multi-Language Support

Supported languages:

* English
* Russian
* Uzbek
* German
* Spanish
* Turkish
* French
* Polish
* Portuguese
* Italian

Adding custom languages is easy through language files.

---

## 💾 Storage Options

* Local YAML storage
* MySQL database support
* Automatic fallback system

Your support, feedback, and suggestions help improve the project and make it better for everyone.
